platform: Linux x86-64; little-endian u64 words and 64-bit borrowed-buffer lengths
scope: Duplicate and required/extra selection, segment lookup, checked output planning and UTF-8 payload copying. Host preserves the exact generic callback and destructor scaffold and owns allocations.

original.parse_dto: Template { placeholders: BTreeSet<String>, segments: Vec<Segment> }, with Segment::Literal(String) and Segment::Placeholder(String). No new public fields, variants or signatures.

host_placeholder_storage.native: The Index Builder compares original parse ranges and selects unique names and byte order. finish() moves owned strings by native ID into Placeholders(Vec<String>) and drops the temporary Index.
host_placeholder_storage.render_frame: Serialize Template::placeholders() through its ExactSizeIterator, retaining its count and order without Rust sorting or normalization.
host_placeholder_storage.default: The original nonnative BTreeSet and Rust parser/render stack remain unchanged.
host_placeholder_storage.private_frames: Raw DTO qualification bypasses the Builder. Empty, unsorted, duplicate and inconsistent declared/segment inputs retain their original validation and priority semantics.

calling_convention_and_frame.return_type: u64 carrying the fixed transport status
calling_convention_and_frame.byte_order: Little endian; fields may be unaligned. Offsets and lengths count bytes.

operations.0: CheckCandidate: key-log frame only; compare its last key to prior keys and produce a fixed header.
operations.1: FinalQuery: final DTO frame; full validation and semantic/output computation, header only.
operations.2: FinalEmit: identical final DTO frame; repeat full preflight, then header and full rendered UTF-8 bytes.

key_log_frame.body: Starting at byte64, exactly N entries in encounter order. Each entry is u64 name_byte_length followed immediately by that many UTF-8 name bytes. No padding or trailing bytes.
key_log_frame.candidate: The last entry. The operation compares only this candidate against earlier entries. Prior-prefix uniqueness is not falsely claimed as a raw-ABI prerequisite or proven by this operation.
key_log_frame.raw_prefix_semantics: Duplicate keys entirely within an earlier prefix do not themselves cause Duplicate unless the last candidate matches a prior key. The safe host establishes uniqueness inductively by running this operation for every yielded item.
key_log_frame.value_timing: Values are intentionally absent from this frame, but the Rust value AsRef and owned copy must already have completed before the call. The ABI alone cannot prove that host-side timing.

final_frame.constraints: Operation 1 or2; frame_kind=1; N,P,S may each be zero.
final_frame.variable_entry: u64 name_length, u64 value_length, exact name bytes, exact value bytes. Encounter order is retained; names and values may be empty.
final_frame.placeholder_entry: u64 name_length, exact name bytes. Entries must be strictly increasing by unsigned UTF-8 byte order, matching the original BTreeSet iteration. Empty names remain structurally valid for a private DTO; parse18 never constructs one.
final_frame.segment_entry: u64 kind, u64 payload_length, exact payload bytes. kind1=Literal, kind3=Placeholder. These are materialized DTO segments; parse18 append-literal instructions are not accepted here.
final_frame.shape_policy: Do not merge adjacent literals, drop empty literals, trim names or require the segment-placeholder set to equal the declared set. Such extra restrictions would unnecessarily remove the original defensive segment lookup behavior. The public parse-produced DTO already has its stronger invariants.
final_frame.extent: The last record must end exactly at source_len. Counts, header sizes and every advancing cursor use checked arithmetic. No unspecified padding, foreign pointer or out-of-frame reference is accepted.

output_header_words: error_origin: 0 none, 1 variable, 2 declared placeholder, 3 segment
zero-based error entry index within that origin
exact error-name byte offset in source
output_invariants: Successful CheckCandidate writes exactly80 bytes, required=80, semantic_error=0 and all four error-detail words zero.
Semantic error in any operation writes only the80-byte header with required=written=80. CheckCandidate Duplicate points to its last key; final Duplicate points to the earliest second occurrence.

Successful FinalQuery writes80 bytes and reports required=80+R with zero error-detail words. Successful FinalEmit writes exactly required bytes; bytes80..required are the complete rendered UTF-8 string.
Query and emit must agree on source identity, required length and all semantic fields after normalizing only operation and written extent.

Error origin/index/range must identify the exact serialized name field, never a value field or arbitrary matching substring. The host may validate this transport relation without choosing the semantic error.
An empty successful render has required=written=80 in Emit. No artificial minimum output payload exists.

transport_status.0: A fully formed success or semantic-error header was written.
transport_status.4294967294: SHORT: the fully validated selected response requires more output capacity. Source, workspace and the entire supplied output buffer remain unchanged.
transport_status.4294967295: INVALID: unsupported operation/version, malformed frame/reserved fields/kind/order/UTF-8, or checked arithmetic failure. Source, workspace and the entire supplied output buffer remain unchanged.

preflight_order: Validate exact workspace size/version/op/reserved fields and minimum readable input header.
Validate all counts, record extents, kinds, full UTF-8 of every present string, exact final cursor, and declared-set strict ordering. No output writes occur during this traversal.
Evaluate semantic priority and, only on semantic success, calculate the checked full output length.
Check output capacity against the entire selected response:80 on semantic error,80 on Query/Check, or80+R on successful Emit.
Only then write the header and any complete payload. No partial prefix is written on a nonzero return.
calling_convention_and_frame.ffi_preconditions: The caller supplies actual readable/writable live, disjoint buffers for the declared extents. The ABI validates bytes and arithmetic, not forged native pointers. It retains no pointer across calls.
calling_convention_and_frame.size_policy: No static item count, string length or one-MiB cap. Only actual buffer extents, checked u64 arithmetic and the Rust allocation/usize representability boundary apply.

retain_source_scaffold: Keep a separate variable-building helper with the original for (name, value) tuple pattern and the original shadowing let name = name.as_ref().to_string() statement.

Preserve the existing name.clone() evaluation before value.as_ref().to_string() when entering the transport insertion operation. The insertion operation may contain only allocation/serialization/native dispatch/materialization.

Keep immediate DuplicateValue { name } return in that same iteration scope. No extra next call, prefetch, collecting adapter, size_hint, len, fold, try_fold, nth, cloning of K/V, or iterator trait extension may be introduced.
On each successful step, leave the same current-item scope before requesting the next element. Do not hold K or V in a Vec; only the copied Strings may survive.
On the first None, finish and drop the original for-loop iterator before final template serialization/query or missing/extra error construction. Keeping the helper boundary makes this order explicit.
Do not replace the tuple-pattern loop with a loop over an owned tuple: tuple-field drops and local-binding drops are different language mechanisms.

Do not serialize or validate the Template before the variable helper consumes its iterator. Original Missing/Extra checks occur only after all nonduplicate inputs and the iterator destructor have completed.
per_item_order: K::as_ref is called once; its returned bytes are copied into the local owned name before V::as_ref is invoked.
The local name is cloned for insertion as in the original expression, then V::as_ref is called once and its bytes are copied.
Only now may HIA CheckCandidate run, even if the name is already known to duplicate.
Accepted: keep only owned data, then leave the current iteration scope and ask next again.
Duplicate: construct the original DuplicateValue using the current local name and return immediately; the same current K/V and iterator scopes unwind naturally.
panic_and_drop_boundary: An AsRef or next panic must retain the same earlier event prefix; no HIA duplicate/missing check may move ahead of a callback that the original invokes.
A current item or iterator destructor may itself panic. Do not catch or suppress it, manually drop the iterator early, or convert it into a TemplateRenderError.

For the free render function, malformed parse prevents IntoIterator::into_iter and all next/AsRef calls, but the owned variables argument still drops as the function returns. Zero iteration is not a zero-Drop claim.
Exact user-owned I/IntoIter/K/V event traces are a required future whole-original differential gate, not a claim already established by this design.

Allocation counts, capacities, internal String/map-node deallocation traces and allocator-failure timing are not promised to match the Rust BTreeMap implementation. The original has no allocation-error Result variant; native transport failure must remain distinguishable from Duplicate/Missing/Extra.
generic_effect_contract.one_shot: Keep Template::parse(template)?.render(variables).map_err(Into::into) unchanged. Parse error has priority over all variable callbacks.

semantic_priority: After complete frame preflight, scan variable entries by increasing second-occurrence index; return Duplicate for the first key with any earlier equal key.
Walk the already strictly ordered declared-placeholder table; return Missing for its first name absent from the variable entries.
Only if every required name exists, find the unsigned-byte lexicographic minimum variable key absent from the declared-placeholder table; return Extra for it.

Walk segments in order. Literal contributes its exact payload; Placeholder selects the exact matching variable value. Preserve the original defensive Missing return for the first missing segment key, even in a privately inconsistent DTO.
Calculate the full checked output extent; Emit repeats validation/selection before writing the selected literal/value bytes. Values are never reparsed, escaped, normalized or recursively expanded.

performance.definitions: N=consumed variables before termination, P=declared unique names, S=segments, K_j=all key bytes through item j, B=final frame bytes, M=1+maximum name byte length, R=rendered output bytes.
performance.incremental_duplicate_total: Each CheckCandidate validates its whole current key log and compares the last key against the prefix: O(K_j+j*M). Over N accepted items the conservative bound is O(sum_j K_j + N^2*M). The key-log Vec itself is appended amortized linearly; it is not rebuilt from all prior values on every item.
performance.final_query: With simple scans and no native allocation, O(B + (N^2 + P*N + S*N)*M). The raw final duplicate check is defensive even though the safe host has already established uniqueness.
performance.final_emit: Same validation/selection cost as Query, plus O(R) byte copying.
performance.space: O(K+V+template_bytes+R) host memory with explicit temporary constant factors; O(1) additional native algorithm state if scans use counters/ranges. No recursive tree, hash-table reserve or count-limited scratch arena is required.
performance.comparison_to_original: The original BTreeMap uses logarithmic insertion/lookup. This initial native protocol can regress many-key workloads and has no performance qualification. An HIA-owned index can later reduce this cost, but it must preserve streaming callback timing and strict raw-buffer validation.
